newsitem.title: USA: Claire's Stores sees good Feb sales.
newsitem.headline: Claire's Stores sees good Feb sales.

text.p: Investors worried that Claire's Stores Inc will not approach the 21 percent sales surge it posted last month when it reports its February sales can relax, President Les Dunavant said on Wednesday.
"I think you will see that we'll pass the test with flying colors," Duvant told investors at a conference sponsored by Robert James & Associates Inc.
Dunavant gave no details of the February sales figures, which the teenage specialty company will report Thursday.

Chief Financial Officer Ira Kaplan said the company expected to earn $1.12 to $1.15 a share in the fiscal year ending next January 31 and sales were likely to be between $500 million and $510 million.
Claire's Stores operates low-price accessories shops in U.S. malls and some overseas maarkets and targets teenagers.
